documentation.rationale: There is an itemised equipment list, an odometer photo and a clean-title checkbox. There is no VIN, no history report and no invoice for the large claimed engine job. The identity half is incomplete and the maintenance half is seller prose only.

condition.rationale: Exterior and interior photos show a tidy truck with mileage-consistent seat and wheel wear, and no warning lamps in the cluster photo. However, the claimed head-gasket and timing-chain work implies a significant prior engine fault, repaired by an unknown shop with no paperwork. KDSS, air injection, rear air suspension and the underside are all unproven.

price_value.rationale: $16,995 is about 15% above the top of the $12,145–$14,779 fair-value band. The claimed engine work could justify a premium only if invoiced, and it is not. The car has sat 18 weeks and been relisted.

mission_fit.rationale: Body-on-frame, low range, roof rails and a receiver hitch supply capability the RX lacks, at a price inside the budget band. Mileage is acceptable for a Lexus. The undocumented engine history weakens the reliability case a capability SUV must make.

logistics.rationale: Modesto dealer, roughly 2.5 hours from Carmel. The car is CA-registered and the dealer handles smog. Arranging a nearby PPI should be straightforward, but access is not yet confirmed.

emotional_spec_fit.rationale: Premium trim with ventilated seats, AVS and rear height control, in an attractive maroon. The aftermarket wheels and AT tires are tasteful and mild. Otherwise a typical early GX460.

Is there a written warranty on that engine work, and who honours it?
Can you send a scan showing no stored or pending codes, including P2440/P2442, plus readiness-monitor status?
What are the DOT date codes on all four tires, and what brand and size are they?
Can you photograph the frame rails, the KDSS cylinders and accumulators, and the underside of the engine and transmission?
Does the truck sit level, and has KDSS or the rear air suspension ever been serviced or replaced?
Was the truck used for towing, and what weight?
Will you allow a pre-purchase inspection at an independent Toyota/Lexus shop in Modesto before any deposit?
Can you send a cold-start video from fully cold, with the hood open, idling to operating temperature?
What is the out-the-door price, including doc and emission fees?
ppi_focus: Verify the engine repair quality: coolant pressure test, combustion-gas (block) test, check for leaks at the valley plate and timing cover, and confirm no oil in the coolant.
Full scan with readiness monitors; specifically check secondary air injection pump and valves (P2440/P2442) and pending codes.
KDSS: inspect accumulators, cylinders and lines for leaks; check for lean on level ground.
Rear air springs and AVS: ride height and compressor function; check for suspension warning lights after a drive.
Frame, hitch area and underbody on a lift: rust, towing wear, impact damage, skid-plate scrapes.
Transfer case: H4/L4 engagement and center-diff lock actuator; differential and transfer fluid condition.
Transmission fluid condition and shift quality, including under load.
Tire DOT dates and wear pattern; alignment and bushing wear.
Extended road test watching the temperature gauge, plus a post-drive check for coolant level drop.
what_would_change_verdict: An itemised invoice from a reputable shop for the timing chain and head gasket job, with a warranty, would turn the biggest unknown into a documented positive.
A clean PPI covering pressure and block tests, KDSS, air injection, suspension and frame would raise condition substantially.
A price nearer the $12,145–$14,779 fair-value band, or an out-the-door figure that reflects the absent records, would improve value.
Evidence of an overheat history, a failed block test, KDSS leaks or air-injection codes would move it down sharply.
evidence.mission_note: A GX460 supplies body-on-frame, low-range and roof-rack capability the RX lacks, which fits the utility_capability brief in accelerated_bridge mode. The undocumented engine rebuild history must be resolved before the reliability case holds.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes a 2010 GX460 with Premium-level equipment visible in the photos, 173,709 miles confirmed by an odometer photo, CA registration, and no warning lamps in a running-engine cluster shot. It claims a large, very recent engine job (timing chains, head gaskets, valley gasket, water pump, thermostat), but provides no invoice, shop name or VIN. Head-gasket replacement is not routine on this engine, so the claim raises an unanswered question about a prior overheat or coolant failure. None of the model-critical items — KDSS, secondary air injection, frame/underbody — is evidenced, and tire dates are not shown. The ball mount in the receiver and the AT tires suggest towing or outdoor use that is not explained. At $16,995 the asking price is above the $12,145–$14,779 fair-value band, and the car has sat about 18 weeks with a relist.
evidence.next_action: Message the dealer for the VIN, the Carfax report, and the itemised invoice for the timing chain and head gasket work, and ask for permission for an independent Toyota/Lexus PPI in Modesto before any deposit.
